title: Iranian mourners call for vengeance on Trump during Khamenei funeral procession

snapshot.title: Iranian mourners call for vengeance on Trump during Khamenei funeral procession
snapshot.description: TEHRAN: Crowds of Iranians marched through the streets of Tehran on Monday in a funeral procession for slain leader ​Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, the biggest day yet in a week of massive memorial ceremonies demonstrating the grip of surviving clerical leaders.
